# Preface {.unnumbered}

{{< slidebreak >}}

This website collects the lecture notes for
[CSCI 481](https://morrison-lab.github.io/swc/course/CSCI-481.html),
"Deep Learning",
as taught in Spring Quarter 2027
at [Western Washington University](https://www.wwu.edu/)
by [Douglas Ezra Morrison](https://d-morrison.github.io/).

{{< slidebreak >}}

The course follows the module sequence of
[Brian Hutchinson](https://cs.wwu.edu/hutchib2)'s CSCI 481/581,
which he taught from Winter 2021 to Winter 2026.
Each chapter's collapsed **Source** note records what it draws on.

{{< slidebreak >}}

CSCI 481 builds on DATA 371/471, Machine Learning.
Where these notes use an idea that course covers,
such as generalization, gradient descent, or logistic regression,
they link to its definition in
[*Machine Learning for Data Science* (lds)](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/)
rather than defining it again.

{{< slidebreak >}}

The [Calendar](calendar.qmd) lists the topics week by week,
and the [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd) gives the course's policies.
The main reference text is *Deep Learning* [@goodfellow2016deep],
which can be read at no cost on [the book's webpage](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/).
